campaigns.description: Defend the free world against the Soviet invasion — from New York, Washington D.C., and Chicago to the Chrono Storm assault on Moscow.

missions.briefing: The Soviets have invaded New York Harbor. Assist Special Agent Tanya, re-establish contact with Fort Bradley, and sink the Soviet Dreadnought fleet off Manhattan.
Soviet forces have occupied the Air Force Academy in Colorado Springs. Retake the base with Tanya and your Rocketeers and eliminate all hostile occupation forces.

missions.display_name: Op. 03: Hail to the Chief (Washington D.C.)
missions.briefing: A Soviet Psychic Beacon deployed outside the White House has mind-controlled the President and General Carville. Destroy the Psychic Beacon and liberate the capital.
General Vladimir has erected a massive Psychic Amplifier in downtown Chicago. Launch an amphibious assault across Lake Michigan and destroy the amplifier before activation.
Infiltrate the Soviet nuclear missile silos along the Polish border with Agent Tanya and Allied Spies to persuade the European nations to join the Alliance.
Backed by European reinforcements, launch our counter-offensive to reclaim Washington D.C. and the Pentagon from Soviet occupation.
A massive Soviet Pacific Fleet is bearing down on Hawaii. Build up your naval forces with Aegis Cruisers and Aircraft Carriers to sink the invaders.
Liberate St. Louis along the Mississippi River from the Soviet Psychic Beacon and field Professor Einstein's new Prism Tanks in combat for the first time.
The Soviets are attempting to reverse-engineer captured Prism technology in the jungles of Yucatan. Destroy the research facility and prototype near the Mayan temple.
Soviet tank divisions are marching on Einstein's secret laboratory in the Black Forest. Deploy Mirage Tanks and hold the laboratory at all costs.
Construct and defend the Chronosphere in the Florida Keys against Cuban forces and nuclear missile silos to prepare the direct invasion of Moscow.
The final battle: Your strike force has been teleported directly into Moscow via Chronosphere. Eliminate the Black Guard surrounding the Kremlin and capture Premier Romanov.

campaigns.display_name: RA2: Soviet Red Dawn Campaign (12 Missions)
campaigns.description: Lead the Red Army in a lightning war across Washington D.C., New York, Paris, and Pearl Harbor to the reckoning with traitor Yuri and the final Allied stronghold in Alaska.

missions.briefing: Comrade General, spearhead our invasion of Washington D.C. and crush the Pentagon, the heart of the American military machine.
Establish a beachhead on the coast of Florida and shatter the Allied counterattack fleet with Typhoon Attack Submarines and Rhino Heavy Tanks.
Capture the Allied Battle Lab in Lower Manhattan and defend the construction of our Psychic Beacon until it brings all of New York under Soviet control.
Korean naval forces have launched an amphibious landing near Vladivostok. Repel the invasion fleet and obliterate the enemy beachhead.
Energize the Eiffel Tower into a colossal Tesla Coil using your Tesla Troopers and annihilate the Allied garrison defending Paris.
Seize the Hawaiian islands and sink the remaining Allied Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor using Dreadnoughts and Giant Squids.
The Allies are using their Chronosphere to stage a surprise assault on our Battle Lab in the Ural Mountains. Defend the laboratory against all waves.
General Vladimir has betrayed us and fortified himself inside the White House. Crush his renegade guard and bring Vladimir to justice.

missions.display_name: Op. 09: The Fox and the Hound (San Antonio)
missions.briefing: The US President has entrenched himself inside the Alamo in San Antonio. Use your Psi-Corps operatives to bring him under mind control alive.
The Allies have deployed a Weather Control Device in the Virgin Islands. Field Kirov Airships and Nuclear Missiles to wipe out their base.
Yuri has assassinated Premier Romanov and seized the Kremlin. Obliterate Yuri's Kremlin stronghold with our heavy Apocalypse Tanks and Kirov Airships.

missions.display_name: Op. 12: Polar Storm (Point Hope, Alaska Finale)
missions.briefing: The last Allied Chronosphere stands at Point Hope, Alaska. Destroy it to crown the global triumph of the Soviet Union.

campaigns.description: Travel back in time using Einstein's Time Machine and dismantle Yuri's global network of Psychic Dominators from San Francisco to Antarctica.

missions.display_name: YR Op. 01: Lightening the Load (San Francisco)
missions.briefing: Capture civilian power plants across San Francisco to energize Einstein's Time Machine and stop the Psychic Dominator on Alcatraz Island.

missions.display_name: YR Op. 02: Hollywood and Vain (Los Angeles)
missions.briefing: Yuri is recycling the population of Los Angeles inside his Grinders. Team up with Hollywood's action heroes and destroy every Grinder in the city.
Yuri is blackmailing the Massivesoft Corporation in Seattle with a Nuclear Missile Silo. Liberate the campus and knock out the silo with your Weather Control Device.
Yuri has imprisoned Professor Einstein inside the Great Pyramid of Giza. Rescue Einstein with Tanya and obliterate Yuri's Nile stronghold.
Yuri is operating Cloning Vats in Sydney Harbor to replace world leaders with mind-controlled duplicates. Destroy all Cloning Vats and Yuri's base.
Defend the Houses of Parliament along the Thames until the joint treaty with the Soviets is signed, then storm Yuri's fortress.
Combined with Soviet forces, launch an all-out assault on Yuri's final citadel and Psychic Dominator in the frozen wastes of Antarctica.

campaigns.description: Hijack Einstein's Time Machine, reverse the Soviet defeat in the Black Forest, and hunt Yuri across the Moon to his ancestral castle in Transylvania.

missions.briefing: Seize Einstein's Time Machine in San Francisco, travel into the past, and destroy Yuri's Psychic Dominator on Alcatraz while it is still under construction.
Rewrite history: Destroy Einstein's laboratory and Chronosphere in Germany's Black Forest before the Allies can launch their invasion of Moscow.
Destroy Yuri's Psychic Beacon in London to free the mind-controlled Allied garrison, then join forces to crush Yuri's Psychic Dominator.

missions.display_name: YR Op. 04: Romanov on the Run (Morocco)
missions.briefing: Premier Romanov's plane has been shot down over Morocco. Locate the Premier and escort him safely back to the airfield before Yuri's forces capture him.
Yuri's secret Boomer submarine pens and space launch facility are hidden on a Pacific island guarded by Moai statues. Storm the island.

missions.display_name: YR Op. 06: To the Moon (Lunar Surface)
missions.briefing: Yuri has fled to the Moon! Establish a forward Soviet lunar base with Conscripts, Tesla Troopers, Flak Troopers, Desolators, and Rhino Heavy Tanks, and destroy Yuri's Lunar Command centers.
Yuri has retreated to his ancestral fortress in Transylvania, wielding mind-controlled Allied and Soviet superweapons. Raze his fortress once and for all!

campaigns.description: Interactive step-by-step tactical onboarding: camera & box selection, MCV deployment, base power/economy, dynamic sector expansion, bridge engineering, and armored counterattack.

missions.briefing: Basic Training Day 1: Advance to Waypoint Alpha to assume outpost command, expand into the southern live-fire sector, protect your supply convoy, and clear all OPFOR structures.
Basic Training Day 2: Deploy your MCV, hold the perimeter until the defense countdown completes, capture the Tech Communications Center, and lead Grizzly Battle Tanks against the OPFOR base.
